mapper.select: SELECT email FROM customer WHERE customer_id = #{customerId}
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM customer WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} AND email IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(email) <> '')
SELECT customer_id FROM customer WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT consent.consent_type, consent.agreed FROM customer_consent consent WHERE consent.customer_id = #{customerId} AND consent.consent_type IN ( 'NOTIFY_PUSH', 'NOTIFY_SMS', 'NOTIFY_EMAIL', 'NOTIFY_SETTLEMENT', 'NOTIFY_BAND', 'NOTIFY_COMMENT', 'NOTIFY_KIRU' ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM customer_consent newer WHERE newer.customer_id = consent.customer_id AND newer.consent_type = consent.consent_type AND (newer.changed_at > consent.changed_at OR (newer.changed_at = consent.changed_at AND newer.customer_consent_id > consent.customer_consent_id)) )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO customer_consent (customer_id, consent_type, agreed, changed_at) VALUES (#{customerId}, #{consentType}, #{agreed}, #{changedAt})
